hero.title: Sceaux Serenity — Beautiful home near Paris

about.subkicker: 5 bedrooms · 6 beds · 2.5 baths · up to 11 guests
about._comment_body: Markdown field. Array of paragraphs. Supports **bold**, *italic*, [links](https://example.com), and lists (- item).
body: Welcome to our **beautiful 5-bedroom villa** — the perfect retreat at the gates of Paris, blending comfort, style and convenience.
Relax in bright bedrooms, enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, and unwind in the *private garden* or on the *rooftop terrace*.

Located in **Sceaux**, steps from public transport, the house lets you reach central Paris quickly while enjoying the calm and charm of this leafy town. Perfect for family holidays, romantic getaways or business trips.

features.title: Comfort & space
features.body: King and queen-size beds across five welcoming bedrooms, with 2.5 modern bathrooms at your disposal.

features.title: Fully equipped kitchen
features.body: Everything you need to cook — ideal for family meals or evenings with friends.

features.title: Garden & rooftop terrace
features.body: A private garden to unwind and a rooftop terrace for a sunny coffee or an evening aperitif.

features.title: Paris in minutes
features.body: RER and bus less than a 5-minute walk away, free parking in front of the house. Central Paris is right there.

access.title: Guest access
access.body: You'll have exclusive, full access to the whole house: 5 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, the equipped kitchen, living and dining room, private garden and rooftop terrace. High-speed Wi-Fi, laundry, and self check-in with a secure lockbox.

loc.title: Where you'll be
loc.body: Sceaux, Île-de-France — a leafy residential town just south of Paris. RER B and buses are less than a 5-minute walk and reach central Paris in under 30 minutes. Free parking directly in front of the house.

book.title: Book your stay
book.intro: Book with confidence on our partner platforms, or reach out directly for a tailored stay.
book.directBody: Call or text for a quick reply. We speak French and English.

contact.title: Have a question? We're here to help.
contact.body: For any special request, long stay, or information about the house, write to us directly.
